title: Horr
description: Low quality modpack focusing on horror and guns with friends
body:
**oouaah ouuaha horror, the hororr.**

Cool forge pack to play with friends if wanting to experince something scary or to bunker down and try to fend of hordes of zombies

## Features
- Bunch of spooky mods
- A little bit of preformance mods
- Vehicle mods
- Small amount of farming mods
- Structure mods
- some shaders
- Combat mods
